October 23, 2026 (MLN): Gold price in Pakistan decreased on Friday, with 24-karat gold being sold at Rs424,536 per tola, down Rs7,000. Similarly, 24-karat gold per 10-gram was sold at Rs363,971 after a decline of Rs6,001, according to rates shared by the All-Pakistan Gems and Jewelers Sarafa Association (APGJSA). The price of 22-karat gold was also quoted lower at Rs333,652 per 10-gram. Similarly, silver prices fell in the domestic market, with 24-karat silver being sold at Rs5,865 per tola (-Rs221) and Rs5,028 per 10-gram (-Rs189).
